name: provider_null_incoming_calls misread as a proven zero under indexingStatus: ready
description: task-m2-python-preset.md stage 6: the exact misreading provider_null_incoming_calls (stage 3) exists to prevent - an agent treats the provider's null answer as a proven 'nothing calls this' because indexingStatus is ready, and never mentions the null caveat at all. Before this stage's engine fix, the pre-existing unsupported_no_impact_conclusion check only looked at indexingStatus/requestStatus and stayed silent whenever indexingStatus was ready, regardless of provider_null_incoming_calls - so this exact response/summary pair produced zero violations (confirmed by direct measurement against the unfixed engine). Must-fail fixture 12.

limitationDetails.message: Dynamic dispatch, reflection and runtime wiring are not inferred from a static call hierarchy.
